spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing, High Contrast, Large Touch Targets (Senior-Friendly Design)
spacing_and_layout.input_sizing: min-h-[56px] px-4 text-lg rounded-xl border-2 border-[#E5E7EB] focus:border-[#2D6A4F]
spacing_and_layout.gap_strategy: Wide gaps (gap-8 to gap-12) to reduce cognitive load and prevent misclicks

component_guidelines.buttons: Use solid primary color (#2D6A4F) for main CTAs. Must be huge (min-h-[56px]) for easy tapping. Labels must be explicit (e.g., 'Je cherche un intervenant APA' instead of just 'Chercher').
component_guidelines.cards: Flat solid background (bg-white) over the bone-white base. Use 1px border (border-[#E5E7EB]) and rounded-2xl. Soft or no shadows to maintain a clean, physical paper feel.
component_guidelines.forms: Labels MUST be placed outside and above inputs. High contrast borders on inputs. Explicit error states in warm accent color (#B85042).
component_guidelines.map: Leaflet + OpenStreetMap. Use clear, large custom markers.
component_guidelines.accessibility: WCAG AA+ contrast required (7:1 ratio preferred). `data-testid` attributes are MANDATORY on all interactive elements. Focus states must have a highly visible offset ring.

media.description: Senior exercising with a caring professional in a bright environment
Calm, organic shapes in earthy tones for supportive backgrounds

pages_and_features.home: Two massive primary CTAs: 'Je cherche un intervenant APA' (Patient) and 'Je suis intervenant APA' (Pro). Clean, reassuring hero section using the hero_background.
pages_and_features.patient_search: Search bar (ville). Filters: 'Aujourd'hui', 'Cette semaine', 'À domicile', 'Diplôme vérifié'. Desktop: 2-column layout (Leaflet Map on right, scrollable practitioner cards on left). Mobile: Stacked with toggle for map/list.
pages_and_features.practitioner_card: Information displayed: Nom, Ville, Publics accompagnés, Lieux d'intervention, Disponibilités. Prominent CTA button: 'Demander un rappel'.
pages_and_features.callback_form: Fields: Prénom, Téléphone/Email, Ville, Besoin général, Message optionnel. MUST prominently display disclaimer: 'Ne renseignez pas d'informations médicales détaillées.'
pages_and_features.practitioner_dashboard: Profile setup (Ville, zone, diplôme, publics, lieux). Availability grid by half-days. Clear toggle buttons: 'Confirmer disponibilités', 'Garder disponibilités', 'Indisponible'.
pages_and_features.admin_dashboard: Simple datatable layout. Features: list of practitioners, validate diploma button, hide practitioner button, view callbacks, see last updated timestamps.

technical_instructions.icons: Use lucide-react. Keep them simple, large (w-8 h-8 for main actions), and always paired with text.
technical_instructions.forms_library: react-hook-form with customized shadcn/ui. Remove overly complex interactions.
technical_instructions.animations: Minimal to none. Seniors can find heavy motion disorienting. Focus on clear state changes (hover, active, focus) rather than moving elements.
